info.about: Pokémon Trading Card Game, known in Japan as Pokémon Card GB, is a 1998 digital collectible card video game developed by Hudson Soft and Creatures and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy Color. It is an adaptation of the card game of the same name.
info.why: The North American box shipped with a Meowth promo card, so complete copies that still have the card are chased separately from the bare cartridge.
